motivation: The completed low-conflict closure contains many labeled states. Quotient it before selecting starts for a second forced-barrier search, so later computation is allocated to structural classes rather than labeled duplicates.

export_replay.note: The exact closure replay was already running when this quotient plan was frozen; it is a deterministic data export, not a preregistered hypothesis test.
acceptance: E0_found is false unless a construction is independently verified
closure counts exactly match 16082 E=3 and 73788 E=4
exported graph6 line counts equal the closure counts
the exact scan counters match the prior accepted run

operations: canonicalize every graph and its complement with dense labelg
require equality of the induced ordinary and complement-isomorphism partitions
retain the lexicographically smaller dense canonical label of each graph/complement pair
independently recount K5s in each retained graph and its complement with a recursive bitset implementation
acceptance: all graph6 streams are unique and have order 43
complement is an exact involution on every input
dense and sparse partitions agree for E=3 and E=4
each retained representative independently recounts to its declared objective

next_decision_rule: Use every complement-isomorphism representative if there are at most 10000 total. If there are more, freeze a deterministic stratified schedule by objective, conflict split, degree sequence, and class size before launching any second-barrier search.
claim_boundary: This finite-corpus quotient cannot prove that no Ramsey graph exists and cannot classify low-conflict graphs outside the exported closure.
